meta.homeTitle: Check your USCIS case status — and actually understand it
meta.homeDescription: Enter your USCIS receipt number for a live case status, explained in plain English, with a timeline and typical processing times. Free, no account needed.

home.heading: Check your USCIS case status
home.subheading: Live status straight from USCIS, explained in plain English — with your timeline and what to expect next.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: The 13-character number on your USCIS notice, like IOE0912345678.
howItWorks.step2Body: We read your current status the moment you ask — not from a stale copy.
howItWorks.step3Body: Plain-English meaning, what to do next, and how long cases like yours take.

case.mockBannerBody: Live USCIS credentials are not configured on this environment, so you are seeing a realistic demo status. Add USCIS_CLIENT_ID and USCIS_CLIENT_SECRET to check real cases.

timeline.singleEventNote: We started tracking this case on {date}, so earlier updates aren't shown.

processing.within: You're within the published range of {low}–{high} months.

processing.over: You're past the published upper bound of {high} months.

processing.decidedTotal: Total time from receipt to decision: {months} months.
processing.insufficient: We don't have a filing date yet, so we can't place this case on the published range. A receipt notice date would unlock this.
processing.missingForm: No published processing range for this form yet. We'll show context once USCIS ranges are available.

inquiry.title: You may be eligible for a case inquiry
inquiry.body: USCIS allows inquiries when a case is outside normal processing time. Have your receipt number, filing date, and applicant details ready. We don't draft the inquiry for you.

nearby.insufficient: Not enough comparable cases yet ({n} of the ~{threshold} we need). We'll fill this in as more filings in this receipt block report updates.

errors.notFoundReason3: The number is for a different agency form family

errors.upstreamBody: We couldn't reach USCIS. This is usually temporary — wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.rateLimitedBody: You've checked several cases in a short time. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.staleBanner: Showing the last status we have — USCIS did not respond on the latest check.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.body: Case statuses come from the official USCIS Case Status API. Processing ranges are published USCIS times by form (and office when available). Nearby-case summaries use anonymized lookups from people who checked similar receipt blocks — we never list other people's receipt numbers. Elapsed time for decided cases stops on the decision date. This site is not affiliated with USCIS and is not legal advice.
